node.text:
Wild goals. Big ambition. Mind-blowing skill 🤯🤯🤯 

Women have been elevating the game since day one. And they’ll continue to smash records, set the bar and raise the game for all of football 🥅☄️

Never Settle, Never Done.

It was never about what she got from basketball. It was always about what she gave back. Gigi gave inspiration to her teammates, her mentors, and the next generation. #PlayGigisWay @mambamambacitasports

Tiger would. Would you?
Break barriers. Set records. Play through pain and never call it a comeback. 

Tiger is never done.

Don’t call this the perfect Hollywood ending, because this is just the beginning. 

LA is never done.

ADVANTAGE, @rafaelnadal. 
 
1. FIRST SLAM ONLY NINETEEN YEARS OLD. 
2. SECOND SLAM. 
3. THIRD SLAM.
4. STILL UNDEFEATED ON CLAY.
5. GREATEST GAME EVER. FIVE SET THRILLER TO CLAIM FIRST TROPHY AWAY FROM CLAY. THEN THE GOLD MEDAL.
6. FIRST HARD COURT SLAM AT AUS.
7.  BACK TO WINNING WAYS ON CLAY. 
8. SECOND WIN AT SW19.
9. FIRST TRIUMPH AT FLUSHING MEADOWS MEANS TROPHY CABINET IS NOW FULL. 
10. 6TH FRENCH.
11. RECORD BREAKING SEVENTH FRENCH. 
12. RECORD EXTENDING EIGHTH FRENCH. 
13. SECOND US.
14. MOST CONSECUTIVE FRENCH TITLES BUT WHAT FOLLOWS IS TWO YEARS WITHOUT WINNING A TROPHY. IS IT THE END OF HIS CAREER? 
15. DEFIES THE DOUBTERS BY BECOMING THE ONLY MAN TO WIN TEN TROPHIES IN A SINGLE SLAM. 
16. THIRD US. 
17. RECORD EXTENDING ELEVENTH FRENCH.
18. RECORD EXTENDING TWELFTH FRENCH.
19. FIVE SET EPIC US TITLE. 
20 RECORD EQUALING 20TH SLAM. 
 
DEUCE. 
 
21. ADVANTAGE, NADAL.

Welcome to NIKELAND on @roblox, where sport has no rules. Sound on 🔊 @champagnepapi 

Hit the link in our bio and start exploring!

“It doesn’t matter where you start because when you play to lift your people, no hoop is too high.” 

The world may know @giannis_an34 as an MVP and NBA champion, but it’s his work off the court that’s truly special. 

The AntetokounBros Academy is more than basketball, it’s a space where kids from diverse backgrounds are given the chance to unleash and develop their potential through sport. Where everyone and anyone feels they belong. 

With the help of @onassis.stegi and @eurohoops_official, Giannis has created something that he never had growing up. A place where you’re encouraged to follow your passion and where having fun is as important as working hard. On or off the court, one thing is for certain, Giannis is Never Done changing the game.

“When you figure out what makes you happy, you gotta keep doing it because you’re gonna be the best version of yourself.”

🎥 @hael_ky
📸 @eleni.albarosa
🎨 @nique.one

⠀
⠀
“I think it is really important for black women to see themselves in others. We need to start sharing our stories more. We need to find ways to support each other, talk about hair and running because my gosh it’s hard. And also celebrate each other.” - @j_nesi
⠀
The final episode of the Common Thread series with Uninterrupted highlights those who relentlessly go forward together, from the track to the streets. Celebrating the power of sport to create community, inclusivity and sisterhood, athletes @vashtizzle, Jasmine Nesi of @rungrlco, and @sahraisha of @asra.club emphasize how our strides are united, moving through a marathon of collective progress. #BHM #UntilWeAllWin
⠀
🗣️: Vashti Cunningham
🎥: @childotu

Together, a prodigy from Brazil who became the face of modern ballet, and a young dancer in Florida uplifting anyone who sees him move are united by a common thread.

Check, check. Is this on? 🎤 Louder? OK, how about now... WELCOME! To your life, well lived. To your inner circle, expanded. To your personal expression of wellness, celebrated. It’s already within you — we’re just here to amplify it 🗣️.

The Nike Well Collective is your home for Movement, Mindfulness, Nutrition, Rest and Connection. Here, you’ll find people, intel and inspiration to help you balance the hell yeses and hot messes, the everyday and the not-todays ✨.

Because wellness isn’t a win — it’s a way. Welcome to #NikeWellCollective. #LifeWellLived
Congrats to the Joker and the @nuggets on a franchise-first NBA Championship.

@lavellerose 🤝🏼 Tiempo.
 
In the latest Unpacked episode, Rose shares her favorite Nike products – both on and off the pitch. Her love for a comfy Groutfit is something we can all get behind. Shop all her looks at our link in bio.

Treble. 
Player of the Year. 
League Top Goalscorer. 
European Top Goalscorer. 

@erling.haaland has just accomplished one of the most incredible seasons ever. And he’s just getting started.

#Force9 #NikeFootball

Les Champions x3 🎾

Congratulations @diededegroot, @tokitooda, and @nielsvink on each taking home the hardware with major title wins in Paris. 🏆 Keep building your legacies and pushing the game forward.

Believe it, chase it, break it. 🥇

Congratulations to @jakobing on a new world record time of 7:54.10 for 2 miles in Paris.

After this @serenawilliams 2013 victory, she entered her GOAT era 🐐 by going 186 weeks straight at # 1. What about this tournament made it different from the others? A handwritten note of encouragement from Serena to Serena found inside the pocket of her blazer. Tennis was forever rewritten.  🎾

These 2013 Serena Williams artifacts have been supplied by the Department of Nike Archives.

Barriers broken like never before for you to change the game forever after.

Introducing the 𝐚𝐥𝐥-𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐦 𝐋𝐮𝐧𝐚 — the ultimate boot created by women, for women. Join the ranks of the game changers like @debinhaa7 and push your limits on the pitch with 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐦 𝐋𝐮𝐧𝐚. Available in the Nike App and nike.com on June 28. 🌙
#NikeFootball

A boot that changes football for athletes changing  everything.

The 𝐚𝐥𝐥-𝐧𝐞𝐰 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐦 𝐋𝐮𝐧𝐚 was forged at the core by female footballers, including @cdunn19 @debinhaa7 and @grace_geyoro. A first-of-its-kind boot to transform the game.

Equipped with ground-breaking precision and game-changing agility, the 𝐏𝐡𝐚𝐧𝐭𝐨𝐦 𝐋𝐮𝐧𝐚 is available June 28 in the Nike App and nike.com.

The stage is set, the world is watching, and history is about to be made. 🌙
#NikeFootball
